subject: Cancel idle Lane B candidate delegation; Lane A takes exact candidate run
body: Patrick directed continuous A/B coordination and forward progress. Fresh read shows Lane B control arm complete, no active Lane-B candidate Python process, no candidate result file, and the bus has remained idle after Lane-A status request. I am explicitly cancelling only the remaining candidate-execution delegation (not Lane B review authority) and reassigning the exact already-committed candidate run to Lane A. No probe/source edits: same head dd342312..., same rows4096-4103, same runtime binding V2, acceleration_backend=fla_triton_full, no optimizer, no weight mutation. After result Lane A will persist/publish it and Lane B remains the hostile reviewer of the frozen evidence cut.
